name: Peter Tang
role: Keeps the takeaway on the parade with his wife; came from the New Territories in 1968

temperament.from: chosen by the data-build wave 2 job from the person's card

lines.note: own lines live in lines/ (a record each); see lines/README.md

card.who: He and his wife Lily keep the Golden River, the Chinese takeaway at the north end of the parade, and live over it. Open five till half eleven.
card.speak: Polite, careful, dry sense of humour. northern vowels after twenty years.
card.life: Came from Hong Kong in 1969. Buys vegetables at Copper Row market every morning. The late trade means he sees who is about at eleven.
card.fire: They were still up. He saw the glow and rang 999 from the phone box.
card.rivals: Cammack's lads come in late, loud, and pay. Agar is his landlord and the rent went up in spring.
